name: deskfolio
description: DeskFolio: notes locker, class links & history, and verified educator leaderboard (MERN)

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.demo: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix server run dev:demo" "npm --prefix client run dev"
